title: </sub>  Scope the five-run minimum to fixture evidence
text:
</sub>  Scope the five-run minimum to fixture evidence

When a real-PR cohort has exactly one matched sweep-on and sweep-off run per head, AC15(d) explicitly permits comparative recall and cost claims (lines 714–716), but this unqualified business rule declares all sweep recall evidence invalid unless it has at least the five runs in the 2026-09-10 fixture baseline. Those rules give opposite admissibility results for the same evidence; scope this minimum to seeded-benchmark evidence or require the same repetition in AC15.
